draft.subject: Re: How's the first week going?
draft.body:
Hi Sofia,

Thanks for the update -- glad getting everyone set up is on the list this week. I also saw Tariq closed out the notification badge ticket; do flag it if that doesn't match what you're seeing.

When you're ready, projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield, and tasks live inside them, so creating that first project is the natural starting point. Teammates can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and they can also be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Would a short call this week help? Happy to walk through the first project with you.

Best,
Nadia
